### scenario every_op probe
--- config
config alpha 'alpha'
	option v 'A'
	list l 'x'
	list l 'y'

config beta
	option w '1'

config beta
	option w '2'
--- delta
probe.alpha.v='Z'
probe.alpha.q='it'\''s'
|probe.alpha.l='z'
~probe.alpha.l='x'
probe.cfg0389a1.w='9'
-probe.cfg0289a1
+probe.cfg04eae8='gamma'
probe.new='delta'
@probe.alpha.v='vv'
@probe.alpha='aa'
^probe.aa='2'
-probe.aa.q
probe.aa.l='single'
--- show -X
probe.cfg0389a1=beta
probe.cfg0389a1.w='9'
probe.cfg04eae8=gamma
probe.aa=alpha
probe.aa.vv='Z'
probe.aa.l='single'
probe.new=delta
--- show
probe.@beta[0]=beta
probe.@beta[0].w='9'
probe.@gamma[0]=gamma
probe.aa=alpha
probe.aa.vv='Z'
probe.aa.l='single'
probe.new=delta
### end
### scenario lists_and_types p
--- config
config a 'n1'
	option o 'single'
	list l 'x'
	list l 'y'
	list l 'x'
	option k 'K'

config b
	option w '1'
--- delta
p.n1='newtype'
|p.n1.o='two'
~p.n1.l='x'
-p.n1.l='0'
^p.n1='99'
+p.cfg03b616='q'
@p.cfg02b607='named'
-p.named.w
p.n1.m='line1
line2'
p.n1.d='a"b\c'\''d'
|p.n1.l='last'
--- show -X
p.named=b
p.n1=newtype
p.n1.o='single' 'two'
p.n1.l='last'
p.n1.k='K'
p.n1.m='line1
line2'
p.n1.d='a"b\c'\''d'
p.cfg03b616=q
--- show
p.named=b
p.n1=newtype
p.n1.o='single' 'two'
p.n1.l='last'
p.n1.k='K'
p.n1.m='line1
line2'
p.n1.d='a"b\c'\''d'
p.@q[0]=q
### end
### scenario counter p
--- config
config a 'n1'

config b
--- delta
p.newsec='t'
+p.cfg04b619='t'
+p.cfg05b619='t'
-p.newsec
+p.cfg06b61a='u'
--- show -X
p.n1=a
p.cfg02b607=b
p.cfg04b619=t
p.cfg05b619=t
p.cfg06b61a=u
--- show
p.n1=a
p.@b[0]=b
p.@t[0]=t
p.@t[1]=t
p.@u[0]=u
### end
